name: star-control
description: Route Codex development work through Star-Control MCP actions, CLI-only features, Profiles, and an explicit native fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Use Star-Control MCP, CLI, and Profiles.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the installed Star-Control gateway, resolves declarative Profiles, invokes only ready MCP actions, uses the installed CLI only for Catalog-declared CLI-only features, and records native fallback without promoting uncertain states.
defaultPrompt: Use $star-control-operations to route this task through Star-Control MCP actions or CLI Profiles while preserving approvals, evidence, and fallback status.
